form.consentAgree: I agree to the collection and use of my personal data.
form.consentText: Studio115 ("the Company") collects your name, contact details, email and project information to handle consultation requests. This data is used only to respond to your inquiry and is destroyed without delay once that purpose is fulfilled, unless a retention period applies by law. You may decline consent; declining may limit our ability to process your inquiry.

form.errorBody: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly or call us.

process.title: WORK PROCESS
process.subtitle: How a project runs
process.intro: From first inquiry to aftercare, a Studio115 project runs in seven steps.

1.title: Online & phone inquiry
1.body: Tell us the outline of the project via the form or by phone.

2.title: Studio consultation
2.body: We discuss requirements, budget and schedule in detail at the studio.

3.title: Site survey & contract
3.body: We survey the site, finalise the estimate and sign the contract.

4.title: Design meetings
4.body: We review drawings, 3D and material proposals together and lock the design.

5.title: Construction
5.body: A designer manages the site through construction.

6.title: Completion & photography
6.body: We check finishes, complete the work and photograph it if needed.

7.title: Aftercare
7.body: We support defect repair and maintenance.
